tests.name: native_word_empty_datastore_preserves_body_and_round_trips
assertions: Exact paragraph text and count; empty data-store presence survives snapshot and canonical publication.
tests.scope_limit: Plain paragraph and empty metadata only; other producer metadata remains uncovered.

tests.name: native_word_write_reservation_keeps_exact_hash_and_five_paragraphs
assertions: Five native paragraph markers; exact 120-byte write-reservation SHA-256; absent legacy reservation; snapshot and model-writer preservation.
tests.scope_limit: Passive hash retention only; no authentication or document protection execution.

tests.name: native_word_run_edit_preserves_empty_datastore_and_source_snapshot
assertions: One body run replacement survives save/reopen with empty metadata and original source bytes intact.
tests.scope_limit: Single run replacement only; other transaction operations remain uncovered.

tests.name: native_word_datastore_documents_retain_markers_through_model_writer
assertions: Native body markers and full parsed body text survive canonical model writing; data-store presence and table/field counts retained.
tests.scope_limit: Counts do not establish semantic completeness of fields, pictures, objects, protection or embedded fonts.

tests.name: native_word_bidi_and_east_asian_text_retains_unicode_scalars
assertions: Exact Arabic, Hebrew, Japanese and Chinese text before and after canonical writing.
tests.scope_limit: Unicode text only; shaping, direction and East Asian layout properties remain uncovered.

tests.name: native_word_structural_opaque_tables_preserve_source_and_refuse_canonical_loss
assertions: Native table and body markers; empty data store retained on snapshot publication; canonical writer returns InvalidInput before writing any bytes for structural opaque owners.
tests.scope_limit: Explicit canonical-writer boundary from the current feature matrix; supported source-splice edits are tested separately.

tests.name: native_word_table_grid_exposes_all_four_cell_values
assertions: Exact 2x2 Table Grid cell values: Key, Value, RTF_CELL_006 and 42 before and after snapshot publication.
tests.scope_limit: Basic table read only; nested, merged and floating tables remain uncovered.

tests.name: native_word_table_cell_edit_preserves_every_unrelated_source_byte
assertions: Changing one table cell produces exactly the source bytes with its text replaced; neighbor cell and data store retained; source snapshot unchanged.
tests.scope_limit: Single table-cell text operation; no general opaque-owner edit claim.

tests.name: native_word_review_retains_insert_delete_and_comment_content
assertions: Two typed insertion/deletion revisions with expected native text; both native comment/reply texts survive canonical publication.
tests.scope_limit: Content and revision type only; authors, ranges, threading, accept/reject and review mutations remain uncovered.

tests.name: native_word_mail_merge_preserves_empty_file_table_and_inert_source
assertions: Empty file table, native merge settings, source/query text and cached conditional result; three standalone merge fields and two counters; metadata and body retained through canonical writing.
tests.scope_limit: No query execution, source access, field evaluation or merge execution; nested field syntax is retained in its parent instruction.

tests.name: native_word_table_style_retains_all_seven_conditional_definitions
assertions: Seven native table-style definitions with distinct scopes and unchanged based-on identity survive stylesheet writing; rich table document parses with body markers.
tests.scope_limit: Conditional format retention only; no application of styles or rendering, and no general table mutation claim.

tests.name: native_word_vector_group_retains_unstarred_result_and_source_bytes
assertions: Field-owned Graphic 3 group and its three-child legacy result retained; closed polygon has 20 points; body markers and exact original source bytes survive reopen.
tests.scope_limit: Known drawing properties and unchanged repeated section defaults only; no rendering or SmartArt semantic reconstruction.

tests.name: native_word_tracked_move_markers_coexist_with_insert_delete_revisions
assertions: Two move identities retain kind, tag, author and date; inserted/deleted moved text survives in revisions; source publication is byte-identical.
tests.scope_limit: No move execution or accept/reject; deleted text lives in revision content rather than visible body bookmark ranges.

tests.name: native_excel_metadata_reader_keeps_every_worksheet
assertions: All five worksheet names and accessible sheet handles; two exact consolidation ranges and source names; native 28-byte printer-driver payload.
tests.scope_limit: No print execution, consolidation recalculation or full metadata-family claim.

tests.name: native_excel_workbooks_never_silently_lose_worksheet_substreams
assertions: Expected worksheet counts for every unencrypted native XLS/XLT; exact retained SortData and key ranges in two native books; typed version-15 external table metadata.
tests.scope_limit: Catalog coverage plus selected sort/table metadata only; encrypted XLS and remaining worksheet semantics are separate work.

tests.name: native_doc_reads_unicode_paragraphs_through_public_views
assertions: Native body markers and multilingual Unicode text; paragraph query results propagate errors and resolve back through public paths.
tests.scope_limit: Main document text and paragraph traversal only.

tests.name: native_docx_reads_unicode_paragraphs_through_public_views
assertions: Native body markers and multilingual Unicode text; paragraph query results propagate errors and resolve back through public paths.
tests.scope_limit: Main document text and paragraph traversal only.

tests.name: native_xls_keeps_all_five_metadata_worksheets
assertions: Five exact worksheet names, rich/Unicode text markers, and complete cell-query traversal with resolvable paths.
tests.scope_limit: No full formatting, formula, print or metadata claim from text and traversal checks.

tests.name: native_xlsx_keeps_all_five_metadata_worksheets
assertions: Five exact worksheet names, rich/Unicode text markers, and complete cell-query traversal with resolvable paths.
tests.scope_limit: No full formatting, formula, print or metadata claim from text and traversal checks.

tests.name: native_xlsb_keeps_all_five_metadata_worksheets
assertions: Five exact worksheet names, rich/Unicode text markers, and complete cell-query traversal with resolvable paths.
tests.scope_limit: No full formatting, formula, print or metadata claim from text and traversal checks.

tests.name: native_ppt_reads_three_slides_and_table_text
assertions: Exactly three slides, fixture identity, bullet text and six native table labels/values through public presentation views.
tests.scope_limit: Slide text projection only; PPT shape-count fallback does not establish shape parsing correctness.

tests.name: native_pptx_reads_three_slides_and_table_text
assertions: Exactly three slides, fixture identity, bullet text and six native table labels/values through public presentation views.
tests.scope_limit: Slide text projection only; PPT shape-count fallback does not establish shape parsing correctness.

tests.name: native_rtf_edit_reopen_and_inverse_keep_the_original_word_source
assertions: Public run edit survives save/reopen; inverse patch restores exact source; whole-paragraph replacement of mixed formatting has a precise refusal and leaves input unchanged.
tests.scope_limit: Run text transaction only; other operation families remain uncovered.
